title: Weighted moment tail bound
statement:
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$, let $f:I\to\mathbb R$, and let $q,c>0$. Then
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i\mathbf 1_{\{c\le|f_i|\}}\le\left(\frac{\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|f_i|^q\right)^{1/q}}{c}\right)^q.
\]
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, $f:I\to\mathbb R$, and $q,c>0$. Then $\sum_{i:c\le|f_i|}w_i\le((\sum_iw_i|f_i|^q)^{1/q}/c)^q$.
